datasheet.source: National LM108/LM208/LM308 data sheet (Dec 1994), Electrical Characteristics, LM308
datasheet.note: Large-signal voltage gain at 25 °C, ±15 V: min 25 V/mV (87.96 dB), typ 300 V/mV (109.5 dB).

datasheet.source: National LM108/LM208/LM308 data sheet (Dec 1994), Typical Performance Characteristics LM308, Open Loop Frequency Response (Cf = 30 pF)
datasheet.note: Read off the curve (image) by tracing its pixels: 71.4 dB at 111 Hz, 51.6 dB at 1.1 kHz, 33.0 dB at 10.9 kHz, 13.2 dB at 111 kHz, i.e. 0.41-0.51 MHz; about 34 dB at 10 kHz. Not checked: the sheet gives no spread. The model is about 23 % (1.5 dB) above this typical curve.

datasheet.source: National LM108/LM208/LM308 datasheet (Dec 1994, TL/H/7758): output voltage swing ±14 V typ, ±13 V min, RL = 10 kΩ, VS = ±15 V
datasheet.note: Not checked against the minimum: the card stops 2.01 V from each rail, 12 mV past the sheet's ±13 V minimum (2.0 V of headroom). Kept, since the Rat starter needs it; its swing rating is the sheet's typical.

datasheet.source: National LM108/LM208/LM308 datasheet (Dec 1994, TL/H/7758): output voltage swing ±14 V typ, ±13 V min, RL = 10 kΩ, VS = ±15 V
